jyutping: hai2 zi1 piu3 bui3 min6 cim1 meng2

english.note: Use this plain construction when describing the physical act of signing the back of a cheque.

examples.english: I need to endorse the cheque by signing the back before cashing it.
examples.traditional: 我攞張支票去銀行兌現之前，要喺支票背面簽名。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 lo2 zoeng1 zi1 piu3 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 deoi3 jin6 zi1 cin4 jiu3 hai2 zi1 piu3 bui3 min6 cim1 meng2
